accent-wall.purpose: The wall itself, seen only in the home page's mirror; room, not enamel.

bezel-chrome.purpose: The mirror bezel: a 160deg gradient #eef1f5 0%, #8a9098 18%, #d6dce4 40%, #6c727a 62%, #c3c9d1 82%, #7f858d 100% (stops in gradient order).

nosing-chrome.purpose: The counter's 3px front edge: a 90deg gradient #5f646b, #dfe4ea 22%, #8f959d 48%, #f2f4f7 72%, #6a7078 (stops in gradient order).

counter.purpose: The counter's black, under a fall #1b1918 to #121110 (at 1.75rem) to #0d0c0b.

glass-ink.purpose: Lettering on the mirror glass that is not a figure: the hook's description, the day line's labels.

glass-ink-quiet.purpose: The day line's notes on the glass.

brass-escutcheon.purpose: The drawer's lock plate: radial at 35% 30%, #f3dfae, brass at 48%, #7d6231.

keyhole.purpose: The keyhole cut into the lock plate, with a white 25% lower lip.

felt.purpose: The floor of the drawer's tray, lined in the wall's fine grain, under a black 60% fall from the counter's edge.

tray-divider.purpose: The raised divider standing in the drawer's tray, lit along its top (white 7%).

headline.purpose: Section headings in Oswald caps, tracked (.rz-heading).

figure.purpose: Prices, totals and counts in Oswald (.rz-figure); standalone figures only.

body.purpose: Prose, rules, notes; system sans, max 65ch.

label.purpose: Stat labels and panel legends, uppercase (.rz-label).

input.purpose: Typed text in fields: 16px so iOS never zooms (14px from sm where set: the ledger, the drawer's PIN field).

micro.purpose: Table headers, small uppercase tags and the walkthrough's sync connector, uppercase and tracked.

hook.purpose: The home h1: 2.5rem phones, 3.75rem from sm, clamp(3rem, 4.4vw, 4rem) from lg; three set lines.

plate-pos.purpose: Open the POS: 2.125rem, 2.5rem from sm, 2.75rem from xl.

plate-title.purpose: Counter plate titles: 1.25rem, 1.5rem from sm, 1.625rem from lg.

vinyl-label.purpose: Day line labels lettered on the glass, in glass ink.

vinyl-figure.purpose: Day line figures on the label's baseline, bone or brass-bright.

shadows.name: panel
shadows.purpose: Panels and figure strips: the cool LED tube catching the top edge, plus a falling shadow. Paired with a 3.5rem LED wash (rgb(214 228 250 / 0.04) to transparent).

shadows.name: banner
shadows.purpose: The black header banner (rgb(8 7 5 / 0.97) with a rgb(205 214 228 / 0.16) chrome edge).

shadows.name: primary-action
shadows.purpose: Crimson primary buttons: a black shadow, so the enamel sits on the panel instead of glowing.

shadows.name: selected-service
shadows.purpose: The chosen service card on the POS, lifted on panel-2 with a chrome border.

shadows.name: segment-selected
shadows.purpose: The chosen item in a segmented choice.

shadows.name: dialog
shadows.purpose: Dialogs and the payment sheet.

shadows.name: hung-sign
shadows.purpose: The logo banner: in the home mirror, and alone on the POS loading screens.

shadows.name: mirror-bezel
shadows.purpose: The home mirror's chrome bezel on the wall.

shadows.name: mirror-glass
shadows.purpose: The glass set into the bezel.

shadows.name: mirror-led-band
shadows.purpose: A light source, not a shadow: the frosted LED band (3px rgb(240 245 255 / 0.62), 1px blur).

shadows.name: led-tube
shadows.purpose: A light source: the LED tube over the sign in the mirror (3px white 90%, 60% wide).

shadows.name: counter
shadows.purpose: The full-bleed counter; its nosing casts 0 1px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.75), 0 8px 14px -6px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.85).

shadows.name: plate
shadows.purpose: A tool plate lying on the counter.

shadows.name: plate-lifted
shadows.purpose: A plate lifted on hover (motion allowed only).

shadows.name: plate-primary
shadows.purpose: Open the POS at rest; lifted: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.26), 0 1px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.4), 0 28px 34px -18px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.95).

shadows.name: brass-pull
shadows.purpose: The drawer's brass bar pull; its two round mounts cast 0 2px 3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.75).

shadows.name: escutcheon
shadows.purpose: The drawer's brass lock plate.

shadows.name: drawer-front-out
shadows.purpose: The drawer front pulled out, nearer the chair (the plate shadow at rest, lifted 2px when pointed at).

shadows.name: tray
shadows.value: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(214 228 250 / 0.06), inset 10px 0 14px -12px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.9), inset -10px 0 14px -12px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.9)
shadows.purpose: The drawer's tray, in shadow under the counter's edge and between its walls.

shadows.name: nameplate
shadows.purpose: The drawer's brass nameplate; its black card sits in it: inset 0 1px 3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.85).

motion.name: page
motion.value: out: rz-page-out 180ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 1, 1); in: rz-page-in 360ms ease-out-expo, 120ms later; first load: rz-fade 320ms
motion.purpose: Pages fade through on every navigation (app/template.tsx view transition; back and forward through a still copy, HistoryFade). With a mouse the old page goes soft (2px) and the new comes into focus (from 4px). The room, ribbon and shears carry on. A first load fades the page in; the animate-fade utility is 240ms.

motion.name: room-air
motion.value: fall 2-18px/s by depth; scroll parallax 10%-55% by depth; shears' reach 160px (drag 1.2, part 1, 24px a step); snip puff 240px/s over 200px; settle 2.2/s; switch-on 1.4s
motion.purpose: The room's air drifts, answers the shears and the scroll. Mouse for the shears; phones at 30fps. Never under reduced motion.

motion.name: room-tilt
motion.purpose: The room light tilts up the wall as a page scrolls down, and glides back after a navigation. Still under reduced motion.

motion.name: dialog
motion.value: overlay rz-fade 200ms; panel rz-pop 320ms; phones rz-sheet
motion.purpose: Dialogs pop; the phone payment dialog rises as a sheet.

motion.name: value
motion.purpose: A changed checkout amount flashes brass.

motion.name: station-switch-on
motion.value: LED band rz-fade 700ms, 120ms delay; room and sign rz-lights-up 1100ms, 160ms delay
motion.purpose: The home station switches on: brightness 0.45 and saturate 0.85 to full. Still plays under reduced motion (no movement).

motion.name: pointer-depth
motion.value: transform 900ms ease-out-expo; far room up to ±16px x / ±8px y (--fx/--fy), sign half that (--nx/--ny); sheen background-position (--sx) 900ms
motion.purpose: The mirror's reflection shifts against a mouse pointer; lettering stays still. Never for touch or reduced motion.

motion.name: plate-lift
motion.value: translateY(-3px) 240ms on hover; translateY(-1px) scale(0.99) on press
motion.purpose: A tool lifts off the counter and presses back down. Motion allowed only.

motion.name: keyhole-turn
motion.purpose: The drawer's keyhole turns a quarter once the owner PIN is accepted in the drawer.

motion.name: pole-spin
motion.purpose: The station light turns while the station works.

motion.name: pole-once
motion.purpose: One turn when a service is chosen (its tile light and its striped edge).

motion.name: skeleton
motion.purpose: Loading placeholders in the shape of the coming content.

motion.name: drawer-slide
motion.value: grid-template-rows 0fr to 1fr, 650ms ease-out-expo; the front's shadow lengthens over 600ms
motion.purpose: The drawer loads shut; taken anywhere on its front it slides out (the front moves down, the page holds its scroll) and shut again (the page brings the front back into view).

motion.name: drawer-lift
motion.value: translateY(-2px) 240ms on hover; the pull gives 1px on press
motion.purpose: The drawer front lifts a hair when it is about to be taken. Motion allowed only.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: slides, pops and growth become fades; loops stop; the home mirror rests and plates don't lift; the owner's drawer opens and shuts without sliding and its front doesn't lift; the room is still (no air, no tilt); page transitions keep their opacity fades without blur

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one primary action in an area: Cash, Save, Unlock, Show.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.08); background: var(--color-crimson, #c41f29); color: #fff; font: 600 14px/1.2 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.2), 0 10px 20px -12px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.95); transition: background-color 160ms ease-out, transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-crimson-bright, #da2c35); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: var(--color-crimson-deep, #8c1a20); transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-bone, #f5f0e8); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Every other action: Cancel, Replace, the Shift Log and Cash Reconciliation links.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--color-seam-strong, #45484e); background: var(--color-panel-2, #1e1c1a); color: var(--color-bone, #f5f0e8); font: 600 14px/1.2 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.04); transition: background-color 160ms ease-out, border-color 160ms ease-out; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--color-panel-3, #282522); border-color: var(--color-seam-hover, #5c5f66); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-bone, #f5f0e8); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Cash Pay Button
components.description: The POS's main checkout button: full width, Oswald caps with the amount.
components.css: .ds-pay-cash { width: 100%; min-height: 60px; padding: 14px 20px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.08); background: var(--color-crimson, #c41f29); color: #fff; font: 600 18px/1.2 Oswald, 'Arial Narrow', 'Roboto Condensed', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.2), 0 10px 20px -12px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.95); transition: background-color 160ms ease-out, transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-pay-cash:hover { background: var(--color-crimson-bright, #da2c35); } .ds-pay-cash:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-pay-cash:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-bone, #f5f0e8); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: GCash Pay Button
components.description: Wallet-tinted checkout button, its tint mixed onto a solid panel so the room light never shifts it; Maya and QR Ph follow the same pattern in their colours.
components.css: .ds-pay-gcash { width: 100%; min-height: 60px; padding: 14px 20px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1.5px solid rgb(47 124 246 / 0.6); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-gcash, #2f7cf6) 10%, var(--color-panel, #171514)); color: var(--color-gcash-ink, #8cb8ff); font: 600 18px/1.2 Oswald, 'Arial Narrow', 'Roboto Condensed', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background-color 160ms ease-out, border-color 160ms ease-out; cursor: pointer; } .ds-pay-gcash:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-gcash, #2f7cf6) 18%, var(--color-panel, #171514)); border-color: rgb(47 124 246 / 0.85); } .ds-pay-gcash:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-bone, #f5f0e8); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Field
components.description: Text and number inputs on a chrome edge; typing lights the field crimson.
components.css: .ds-field { width: 100%; min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--color-chrome, #5f6268); background: var(--color-wall-raised, #121110); color: var(--color-bone, #f5f0e8); font: 400 16px/1.4 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; caret-color: var(--color-crimson-bright, #da2c35); transition: border-color 160ms ease-out, box-shadow 200ms ease-out; } .ds-field::placeholder { color: var(--color-dust-2, #958d83); } .ds-field:hover { border-color: var(--color-chrome-hover, #7c8089); } .ds-field:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--color-crimson-bright, #da2c35); background: #151312; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(218 44 53 / 0.24); }

components.name: Tip Choice
components.description: Segmented choice (tips, trend period); the chosen item rises to a neutral raised panel.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: flex; gap: 4px; padding: 4px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--color-seam, #2b2c30); background: rgb(0 0 0 / 0.3); } .ds-seg-item { flex: 1; min-height: 36px; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; background: transparent; color: var(--color-dust, #a69e93); font: 600 12px/1.2 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; transition: background-color 160ms ease-out, color 160ms ease-out; cursor: pointer; } .ds-seg-item:hover { color: var(--color-bone, #f5f0e8); background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.05); } .ds-seg-item[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--color-panel-3, #282522); border-color: var(--color-seam-strong, #45484e); color: var(--color-bone, #f5f0e8); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.06), 0 2px 6px -2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.6); }

components.name: Figure Strip
components.description: Related figures on one hairline-split sheet; money totals in brass, every other figure in bone or its wallet ink.
components.html:
Cash sales₱1400.00
Expected drawer₱1070.00
components.css: .ds-strip { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 14px; border: 1px solid var(--color-seam, #2b2c30); background: var(--color-panel, #171514) linear-gradient(180deg, rgb(214 228 250 / 0.04), rgb(214 228 250 / 0) 3.5rem); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(214 228 250 / 0.13), 0 18px 36px -26px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.95); } .ds-strip > div { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; padding: 14px 16px; box-shadow: 1px 0 0 var(--color-seam, #2b2c30); } .ds-label { font: 600 12px/1.3 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-dust, #a69e93); } .ds-fig { font: 600 24px/1.1 Oswald, 'Arial Narrow', 'Roboto Condensed', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.01em; color: var(--color-bone, #f5f0e8); } .ds-brass { color: var(--color-brass-bright, #e4c584); }

components.name: Barber Pole
components.description: The station light: turns while the station works (POS start, sync, owner pages loading), turns once when a service is chosen, still at rest.
components.css: .ds-pole { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; width: 12px; height: 32px; } .ds-cap { width: 100%; height: 16%; border-radius: 999px 999px 2px 2px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #7f858d, #f6f7f9 42%, #b3b9c1 70%, #6f757d); } .ds-cap-b { border-radius: 2px 2px 999px 999px; } .ds-glass { position: relative; flex: 1; width: 70%; overflow: hidden; background-color: #f5f0e8; background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg, #c41f29 0 3.536px, #f5f0e8 3.536px 7.071px, #2b4aa6 7.071px 10.607px, #f5f0e8 10.607px 14.142px); background-size: 20px 20px; animation: ds-pole 1.1s linear infinite; } .ds-glass::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgb(0 0 0 / 0.45), rgb(255 255 255 / 0.32) 34%, rgb(255 255 255 / 0) 58%, rgb(0 0 0 / 0.5)); } @keyframes ds-pole { to { background-position: 0 -20px; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-glass { animation: none; } }

components.name: Selected Service
components.description: The chosen POS service: a neutral card lifted on panel-2 with a chrome border and a barber-pole edge that turns once.
components.css: .ds-service { position: relative; overflow: hidden; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; width: 100%; min-height: 72px; padding: 14px 16px 14px 20px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--color-chrome, #5f6268); background: var(--color-panel-2, #1e1c1a); color: var(--color-bone, #f5f0e8); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(214 228 250 / 0.14), 0 14px 26px -18px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.95); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-service-edge { position: absolute; inset: 0 auto 0 0; width: 6px; background-color: #f5f0e8; background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg, #c41f29 0 3.536px, #f5f0e8 3.536px 7.071px, #2b4aa6 7.071px 10.607px, #f5f0e8 10.607px 14.142px); background-size: 20px 20px; animation: ds-edge 900ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) 1; } .ds-service-name { font: 600 15px/1.3 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-service-price { font: 600 22px/1.1 Oswald, 'Arial Narrow', 'Roboto Condensed', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.01em; } @keyframes ds-edge { to { background-position: 0 -20px; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-service-edge { animation: none; } }

components.name: Room Light
components.description: The page background: the shop at night, pinned to the screen behind all content. It tilts up the wall as a page scrolls (7% of the scroll, at most 12% of the screen) and never brightens; still under reduced motion.
components.html: Content scrolls over the room light.
components.css: .ds-room { position: relative; min-height: 240px; padding: 24px; background-color: var(--color-wall, #0c0b0a); color: var(--color-dust, #a69e93); font: 400 14px/1.6 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; isolation: isolate; overflow: hidden; } .ds-room::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; pointer-events: none; background-image: radial-gradient(60rem 16rem at 50% -7rem, rgb(222 234 255 / 0.06), transparent 70%), radial-gradient(130% 85% at 50% -15%, rgb(196 31 41 / 0.42), transparent 70%), radial-gradient(85% 70% at 105% 105%, rgb(140 26 32 / 0.36), transparent 70%), radial-gradient(70% 60% at -5% 75%, rgb(140 26 32 / 0.18), transparent 70%); }

components.name: Shop Air
components.description: Fine hair clippings and dust drifting down through the room light, in depth, lit by the room's own lights (warm in the crimson light, all but gone in the dark). The shears catch the light off them, stir them as they pass and puff them on a snip; the scroll moves them by depth and stirs the near ones. Up to 220 specks at 60fps with a mouse; 30-60 at 30fps on a phone, no cursor. Not drawn under reduced motion or without JavaScript.
components.css: .ds-air { position: relative; min-height: 180px; background-color: var(--color-wall, #0c0b0a); background-image: radial-gradient(130% 85% at 50% -15%, rgb(196 31 41 / 0.42), transparent 70%); overflow: hidden; } .ds-speck { position: absolute; left: 30%; top: 26%; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle, rgb(240 200 196) 0 18%, rgb(240 200 196 / 0.35) 30%, transparent 60%); } .ds-speck-b { left: 64%; top: 40%; width: 4px; height: 4px; } .ds-hair { position: absolute; left: 46%; top: 22%; width: 12px; height: 1px; border-radius: 1px; background: rgb(226 196 190 / 0.8); transform: rotate(-24deg); } .ds-hair-b { left: 72%; top: 18%; width: 9px; transform: rotate(38deg); }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: State and wallet pills; colour always paired with words or an icon.
components.html: Online Pending Owner PIN
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 24px; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid; font: 600 12px/1.2 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-pill-ok { background: rgb(52 194 125 / 0.1); border-color: rgb(52 194 125 / 0.32); color: var(--color-ok-ink, #88e0b3); } .ds-pill-warn { background: rgb(239 159 47 / 0.1); border-color: rgb(239 159 47 / 0.36); color: var(--color-warn-ink, #f7c67d); } .ds-pill-brass { background: rgb(201 163 90 / 0.1); border-color: rgb(201 163 90 / 0.4); color: var(--color-brass-bright, #e4c584); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; }

components.name: Station Mirror
components.description: The home page's chrome-bezelled mirror: the reflected room and accent wall behind a frosted LED band, lettering on the glass.
components.html:
Every cut,
counted
once.

The shop's point of sale and end-of-day books.
components.css: .ds-mirror { padding: 9px; border-radius: 30px; background: linear-gradient(160deg, #eef1f5 0%, #8a9098 18%, #d6dce4 40%, #6c727a 62%, #c3c9d1 82%, #7f858d 100%); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.7), inset 0 -1px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.45), 0 2px 4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.5), 0 44px 70px -36px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.95); } .ds-glass { position: relative; isolation: isolate; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 21px; background: var(--color-wall, #0c0b0a); box-shadow: inset 0 2px 8px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.65); } .ds-room { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; background-color: var(--color-wall, #0c0b0a); background-image: radial-gradient(75% 65% at 50% 40%, rgb(140 26 32 / 0.34), transparent 78%), linear-gradient(180deg, rgb(222 234 255 / 0.07), transparent 4.5rem), linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 55%, rgb(0 0 0 / 0.55)); } .ds-wall { position: absolute; top: 2rem; bottom: 0; left: 2.5%; right: 2.5%; background-color: var(--color-accent-wall, #a3161e); background-image: radial-gradient(110% 80% at 34% -8%, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.15), transparent 60%), linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 45%, rgb(0 0 0 / 0.5)); -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #000 10%, #000 90%, transparent), linear-gradient(180deg, transparent, #000 3.5rem); -webkit-mask-composite: source-in; mask-image: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #000 10%, #000 90%, transparent), linear-gradient(180deg, transparent, #000 3.5rem); mask-composite: intersect; } .ds-led { position: absolute; inset: 15px; z-index: 1; pointer-events: none; border: 3px solid rgb(240 245 255 / 0.62); border-radius: 13px; filter: blur(1px); box-shadow: 0 2px 18px rgb(222 234 255 / 0.32), inset 0 2px 18px rgb(222 234 255 / 0.22); } .ds-letters { position: relative; z-index: 2; padding: 56px 48px 40px; text-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.4); } .ds-hook { margin: 0; font: 600 3.75rem/1.05 Oswald, 'Arial Narrow', 'Roboto Condensed', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.03em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-bone, #f5f0e8); } .ds-desc { max-width: 36ch; margin: 16px 0 0; font: 400 1.125rem/1.625 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; color: #f3dcd8; }

components.name: Counter Plates
components.description: Tool plates on the counter: Open the POS in crimson enamel, Shift Log and End-of-Day Cash leather-black; plates lift when pointed at. The owner's drawer is the counter's own drawer under them.
components.html: Open the POSCash · GCash · MayaShift LogEvery sale on this phone.End-of-Day CashClose out today.
components.css: .ds-counter { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.7fr 1fr 1fr; gap: 16px; padding: 28px 24px 48px; background-color: #0f0e0d; background-image: radial-gradient(60% 6rem at 50% 0, rgb(222 234 255 / 0.06), transparent), linear-gradient(180deg, #1b1918, #121110 1.75rem, #0d0c0b); box-shadow: 0 30px 50px -30px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.95); } .ds-counter::before { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 3px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #5f646b, #dfe4ea 22%, #8f959d 48%, #f2f4f7 72%, #6a7078); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.75), 0 8px 14px -6px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.85); } .ds-plate { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; padding: 18px 20px 20px; border: 1px solid var(--color-seam, #2b2c30); border-radius: 14px; background-color: var(--color-panel, #171514); background-image: linear-gradient(180deg, rgb(214 228 250 / 0.045), rgb(214 228 250 / 0) 3.5rem); color: var(--color-bone, #f5f0e8); components.name: Owner's Drawer
components.description: The counter's own drawer under the tools, shut on every page load: a lacquered front with a brass nameplate, the lock and a bar pull, the whole front its handle. Taken, it slides out with the owner's four tools in its tray (Barber Ledger, Insights, Payment QR and the 7-day forecast, which asks for the owner PIN).

components.name: Shop Cursor
components.description: Barber's shears as the mouse pointer on every page: closed at rest, open over clickable controls, a snip with falling clippings on press; text fields keep the text cursor; still SVG cursors under reduced motion. Touch screens unaffected.
components.css: @media (pointer: fine) { html { cursor: url(/cursors/scissors.svg) 3 3, auto; } a[href], button:not(:disabled) { cursor: url(/cursors/scissors-open.svg) 3 3, pointer; } }

narrative.overview: The station looks like the shop after closing: matte black walls lit by the crimson accent wall's glow and a cool LED tube, black leather with chrome trim, the crimson accent wall with the black logo banner, and the barber pole by the door. Every screen is a working tool first, so the world lends only type, palette, density and one signature move, and the controls stay standard. Brass is rare on purpose, crimson means act here or cash, the barber pole lights only for state, and warnings are a hotter amber with an icon. The home page shows the world as a scene: a barber's station seen from the chair, the chrome-bezelled mirror reflecting the room over a black counter where the day's tools lie, and the owner's books in the counter's own locked drawer.
keyCharacteristics: A warm near-black room lit at night: crimson light from the top, embers in the corners, a cool LED tube, fine grain, and clippings and dust drifting through the light
Oswald condensed caps for titles, prices, totals and checkout buttons; system sans elsewhere
The barber pole as the station's state light, never a heading ornament
Figures grouped on one hairline-split sheet
Short, state-driven motion; pages fade through on navigation while the room carries on; the room's air is the one ambient motion

rules.name: The Accent Wall Rule
rules.body: Crimson is enamel for the one primary action and the cash identity (its icon and pill), and the light of the room behind the pages; never a glow on a component, never on a money figure (crimson ink marks only errors and shortfalls). On the home page the Open the POS plate is the one crimson enamel; the Accent Wall colour appears only as the wall reflected in the mirror.

rules.name: The Room Light Rule
rules.body: Background colour comes only from the fixed room light (crimson from the top, embers low in the corners, the LED tube). Translucent identity tints that can sit on it are mixed onto a solid panel so wallet and state colours stay true. The mirror's reflected room is the room light too; its lettering is glass ink, bone and brass.

rules.name: The Brass Ledger Rule
rules.body: Brass marks money that matters and the owner; it is never an alert colour and never the focus ring. On the home page: the day's paid-sales count and prices on the glass, the mustache, and the owner's drawer (nameplate, lock plate, bar pull).

rules.name: The State Light Rule
rules.body: The barber pole lights only for state: turning while the station works, one turn on a chosen service, still otherwise. It never decorates headings.

rules.name: The Wallet Colours Rule
rules.body: GCash blue, Maya green and QR Ph violet belong to their payment methods only. The POS plate names the accepted methods in plain white.

rules.name: The Condensed Caps Rule
rules.body: Oswald for titles, prices, totals and checkout buttons; labels, fields, tables and prose stay in the system sans. Signage is the exception: the home day line's vinyl labels and the board's names are lettered in Oswald.

rules.name: The Tabular Columns Rule
rules.body: Money in columns uses the system sans with tabular numerals so decimals line up, including the walkthrough's drawer sum.

rules.name: The Offset Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows always fall with a soft blur; no zero-offset halos, no hard block shadows. A light source in the scene (the mirror's LED band, the LED tube) glows because it is a light; no component does.

dos: Do use crimson for the one primary action per area and secondary for the rest.
Do put money totals in brass Oswald and status in its state colour with an icon.
Do group related figures in one strip and divide list rows inside a single panel.
Do spin the pole only for real work, and mark a chosen service with its striped edge, not a crimson tint.
Do keep 44px touch targets and 16px inputs on phones.
Do show a skeleton in the shape of the coming content while it loads.
Do mix a translucent identity tint onto a solid panel when the element can sit straight on the room light.
Do keep lettering on the home mirror's glass still while the reflection moves, and keep the station's materials (bezel and nosing chrome, brass hardware, glass ink, the accent wall) on the station.
donts: Don't use crimson or brass as decoration on components: no glows, no tinted selected or inactive states. Crimson light belongs to the room behind the pages.
Don't use Oswald for labels, form fields, tables or prose.
Don't nest cards; use a well or hairline rows inside a panel.
Don't put a kicker or eyebrow above a heading.
Don't load fonts from Google or any CDN; the build and phones work offline.
Don't reuse wallet colours outside their payment methods, or make the gold-serif vintage sign the display voice.
Don't add a second ambient animation or draw the air over content; anything that persists across pages stays out of the page transition.
